questions.q: What was Abraha's economic aim behind building Kulais?
options: To shift the trade hub from Makkah to Yemen
questions.explain: Abraha wanted to restore Yemen's glory and move the trade hub, with religious sentiment as wrapping.

options: A luxurious church built by Abraha in Yemen
questions.explain: Kulais was built to draw people away from the Kaaba.

options: The army with elephants led by Abraha
questions.explain: Ashab al-Fil tried to demolish the Kaaba.

questions.q: What was the name of the main elephant of Abraha's army?
questions.explain: Mahmud refused to move toward the Kaaba even when beaten and prodded.
The people of Taif sent him to guide Abraha.

questions.q: How many camels did Abdul Muttalib ask to have returned?
questions.explain: Abdul Muttalib asked only for his two hundred camels and left the Kaaba to its Owner.

questions.q: What did the ustaz stress about the ababil birds?
questions.explain: Ababil are flocking birds sent by Allah; their kind is not important.

questions.q: Insulting the deities of other religions is not our way and not the sunnah of the Prophet SAW.
questions.explain: True. Al-An'am 6:108 forbids insulting those they call upon besides Allah.

questions.q: Quraysh chose to negotiate because they understood war brings loss to all.
questions.explain: True. Peace and prosperity protect everyone's interests.

questions.q: Put these events in the right order.

items.text: Birds and stones destroy the army
The elephant army heads to Makkah

questions.explain: Abraha seized power, built Kulais, marched on Makkah, his army was destroyed, and the Prophet SAW was born about 50 days later.

questions.q: Match each term with its meaning.

right.text: A tribe's idol kept at the Kaaba as a guarantee of passage
A place about 3.6 km from Makkah

questions.explain: A political hostage was an idol held as a guarantee, kayd is an evil plot, tadlil is loss upon loss, and Al-Murammis is a place near Makkah.

questions.q: You receive news that insults something and stirs anger. What should you do?
options: Be careful, since emotions may be manipulated
questions.explain: News of an insult was used to inflame anger and gather support. The wise are careful.
